author: (Reeve, 1859)

note.en: A small dove snail reported from Moín and Puerto Viejo and between Cahuita and Gandoca. Size and depth are typical values for the group, not measured locally.
note.es: Un caracol paloma pequeño reportado en Moín y Puerto Viejo y entre Cahuita y Gandoca. El tamaño y la profundidad son valores típicos del grupo, no medidos localmente.

evidence: Rodríguez Sevilla et al. 2003: Moín, Puerto Viejo (Robinson & Montoya 1987); Cahuita to Gandoca
Added: not in the original record list for this part
